options.content:
### Saúde de sistema não é saúde de negócio
Esta pasta mostra a infraestrutura. Guarde o horário do incidente da **Fase 2** e volte aqui: enquanto clientes não conseguiam entrar no banco, **tudo nestes painéis ficou verde**. Nenhum destes números teria aberto um chamado — e nenhum deles estava errado.

panels.description:
Resource pressure via PSI

---
**De onde vem este número**

*CPU*
```
rate(node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total{instance="$node",job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])
```
*Mem*
```
rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total{instance="$node",job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])
```
*I/O*
```
rate(node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total{instance="$node",job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])
```
*Irq*
```
rate(node_pressure_irq_stalled_seconds_total{instance="$node",job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])
```
panels.title: Pressure

panels.description:
Overall CPU busy percentage (averaged across all cores)

---
**De onde vem este número**

```
100 * (1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",instance="$node",job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])))
```
panels.title: CPU Busy

panels.description:
System load over all CPU cores together

---
**De onde vem este número**

```
scalar(node_load1{instance="$node",job="$job"}) * 100 / count(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="$node",job="$job"}) by (cpu))
```
panels.title: Sys Load

panels.description:
Real RAM usage excluding cache and reclaimable memory

---
**De onde vem este número**

```
clamp_min((1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{instance="$node", job="$job"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{instance="$node", job="$job"})) * 100, 0)
```
panels.title: RAM Used

panels.description:
Percentage of swap space currently used by the system

---
**De onde vem este número**

```
(node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"} > bool 0) * ((node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"} - node_memory_SwapFree_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"}) / (node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"})) * 100
```
panels.title: SWAP Used
Root FS Used

panels.description:
CPU do **host**, não dos containers. Este é o painel clássico de infraestrutura — e o ponto do encontro é que ele fica verde durante o incidente da Fase 2: recusar login não consome CPU.

---
**De onde vem este número**

*Busy System*
```
avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="$node",job="$job", mode="system"}[$__rate_interval]))
```
*Busy User*
```
avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="$node",job="$job", mode="user"}[$__rate_interval]))
```
*Busy Iowait*
```
avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="$node",job="$job", mode="iowait"}[$__rate_interval]))
```
*Busy IRQs*
```
avg(sum without(mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="$node",job="$job", mode=~".*irq"}[$__rate_interval])))
```
*Busy Other*
```
avg(sum without (mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="$node",job="$job",  mode!='idle',mode!='user',mode!='system',mode!='iowait',mode!='irq',mode!='softirq'}[$__rate_interval])))
```
*Idle*
```
avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="$node",job="$job", mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]))
```
panels.title: CPU Basic

panels.description:
Memória do host. Repare em `Cache + Buffer`: é memória usada pelo sistema de arquivos e liberada sob pressão. Ler *memória cheia* aqui como problema é o erro mais comum deste painel.

---
**De onde vem este número**

*Total*
```
node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"}
```
*Used*
```
node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"} - node_memory_MemFree_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"} - (node_memory_Cached_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"} + node_memory_Buffers_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"} + node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"})
```
*Cache + Buffer*
```
node_memory_Cached_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"} + node_memory_Buffers_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"} + node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"}
```
*Free*
```
node_memory_MemFree_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"}
```
*Swap used*
```
(node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"} - node_memory_SwapFree_bytes{instance="$node",job="$job"})
```
panels.title: Memory Basic

panels.description:
Per-interface network traffic (receive and transmit) in bits per second

---
**De onde vem este número**

*Rx {{device}}*
```
rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{instance="$node",job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])*8
```
*Tx {{device}}*
```
rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{instance="$node",job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])*8
```
panels.title: Network Traffic Basic

panels.description:
Percentage of filesystem space used for each mounted device

---
**De onde vem este número**

```
((node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="$node", job="$job", device!~'rootfs'} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="$node", job="$job", device!~'rootfs'}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="$node", job="$job", device!~'rootfs'}) * 100
```

targets.expr: ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="$node", job="$job", device!~'rootfs'} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{instance="$node", job="$job", device!~'rootfs'}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{instance="$node", job="$job", device!~'rootfs'}) * 100
